sources.title: BFI: James Cameron on The Terminator
sources.primary_basis: First-hand retrospective interview with the film director; George Bass, 21 April 2021. Distinguish Cameron recollections from editorial framing.
sources.access_method: Actual web open and targeted full-page find; read lines 40–54.
supports: Cameron recalls casting Schwarzenegger as the Terminator rather than Reese.
The interview identifies Michael Biehn with Reese.
limits: Does not establish the frozen article precise 1983 casting or February 1984 shooting dates.
Does not replace the complete 1984 cast record or establish Furlong absence.
Retrospective recollection is not a contemporaneous production log.

source_link.title: BFI: Джеймс Кэмерон о «Терминаторе»
source_link.supports: Режиссёр вспоминает выбор Шварценеггера на роль Терминатора; материал различает эту роль и Риза в исполнении Майкла Бина.

sources.title: Amblin: Back to the Future (1985)
sources.primary_basis: Producer company official film page and credits; original publicity/film metadata rather than independent journalism.
sources.access_method: Actual web open and targeted full-page find; read cast/credits and synopsis lines 25–72.
supports: Pairs Marty McFly with Michael J. Fox and Doc Brown with Christopher Lloyd.
Credits Robert Zemeckis and Bob Gale as screenwriters.
limits: Does not verify the five-week Stoltz recast duration.
Does not establish the exact 3 July release date in inspected passage.
Distinct organisation from AFI, but publicity is not independent historical reporting.

source_link.title: Amblin: «Назад в будущее» (1985)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает пары Фокс—Марти и Ллойд—Док, авторов сценария Земекиса и Гейла, а также путешествие из 1985 в 1955 год.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The 58th Academy Awards (1986)
sources.access_method: Actual web open and targeted full-page find; read Sound Effects Editing winner lines 741–747 and film summary 867–874.
supports: Back to the Future won Sound Effects Editing at the 1986 ceremony.
The winners are Charles L. Campbell and Robert Rutledge.
limits: This category differs from Sound, for which the film was nominated rather than winning.
The 1986 ceremony recognises 1985 releases; it is not the release year.

source_link.title: Academy: 58-я церемония «Оскара» (1986)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает победу «Назад в будущее» за монтаж звуковых эффектов; отделяет её от номинации за звук и от года выхода фильма.
